notes:
I couldn't write any notes on Psalm 99 this time. The research tools stopped working before I could read a single page. My first batch of page requests (Enduring Word, the Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit and Barnes commentaries on Bible Hub, Augustine on New Advent, the NET Bible notes and Precept Austin) went over the tool-use limit. A second try at the Enduring Word page was then refused because I had no tool calls left.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Since I read nothing, any note I wrote would come from my own memory, so I've left them all out.

If you ask again in a new turn, I'll fetch these pages one at a time and write the notes verse by verse with a URL for each point:
- **Traditional reading:** Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit Commentary, Barnes), StudyLight and Precept Austin.
- **Protestant traditions:** Spurgeon's *Treasury of David*, plus searches on the Reformed, Methodist, Pentecostal and Lutheran sites. The verses I'd check first are v. 6 (Moses and Samuel called priests) and v. 8 (God both forgiving and punishing).
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes; Augustine on New Advent, which lists this psalm as Psalm 98 because it follows the Greek numbering; and searches on catholic.com and oca.org.
